notes.title: Ace Attorney - That's Wright! Ace Attorney TV!
notes.content:
HOLD IT!

If it pleases the court, defense attorney Phoenix Wright and prosecutor Miles Edgeworth would like to welcome you into the wacky world of Ace Attorney with “That’s Wright! Ace Attorney TV”! Join them as they chronicle the entire Ace Attorney series, starting from the beginning with Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney and the very first “Objection!”.

notes.title: [Notice]Discontinuation of Ace Attorney Turnabout Collection
notes.content:
The Ace Attorney Turnabout Collection bundle(The set SKU of Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy and The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles) will be discontinued as of May 31, 2024.
*New downloads of Ace Attorney Turnabout Collection will not be available in the store, but owners will be able to continue to play game.
*Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy and The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles will remain available for purchase.

notes.title: Apollo's journey begins anew!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YwULOH1QyAE;full][/previewyoutube]
If it please the court, we have new evidence to submit about the lawyers, friends, and rivals of the Wright Anything Agency across all three games included in Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy!

Check the Court Record, and you'll see this collection is packed with a gallery, music player, cutscene viewer, and previously released DLC. Join Apollo Justice, Phoenix Wright, Athena Cykes, and a colorful cast of friends and foes as Apollo puts an end to the Dark Age of the Law!

notes.title: The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles is out now! Take a peek at the Launch Trailer!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DRMV-cNSYio;full][/previewyoutube]

Ready your pointer finger, for The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles is afoot! Check out the Launch Trailer to learn more about some of the characters you'll encounter on your journey.

Head over to the official website for a behind-the-scenes look at the game's development in the latest Dev Blog as well.

※Release dates vary by region. Please check the official website for more details.

Art and Music From the Vaults
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40522024/4fbe9b75dc46cfc9af3ccac6137aaba246549c6c.png[/img]

※Players must purchase The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles by September 1 at 9:59 AM PDT (5:59 PM BST) to receive this content.
※Early Purchase Bonus contents may be made available at a later date for purchase.
※Contents may change without prior notice.
